verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's GitHub repo vast-ai/vast-cli is public and holds the source for its CLI, SDK and serverless client, so part of the product's code is readable. Nothing in the evidence shows the license terms, and the core marketplace platform and console are not shown as open source. Missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g., MIT/Apache), open source for the core platform beyond the client tooling, independent corroboration.
